# Innosin Lab

> Innosin Lab Pte. Ltd. is a Malaysia-based provider of laboratory furniture and equipment since 1986. We distribute four brands across the lab safety, furniture, and ventilation categories.

## Brands & Categories

- **Broen-Lab** (Denmark): Eyewash stations and emergency safety showers.
- **Hamilton Laboratory Solutions** (USA): Premium laboratory furniture and benches with chemical-resistant surfaces.
- **Oriental Giken Inc.** (Japan): Fume hoods, biosafety cabinets, and ventilation systems.
- **Innosin Lab** (Malaysia): Knee Space benches, Mobile Cabinets, Wall Cabinets, Tall Cabinets, Modular Cabinets, Sink Cabinets, Open Racks, and Laboratory Chairs. Cabinets are available in Glass Single/Double Door and Solid Single/Double Door variants.
